$description: PantryPal illustration style spec, extracted from 18 full-res assets across all 6 frames. These images are generated at runtime by an AI image model — this file IS the contract for visual consistency. Human-readable version: docs/illustration-style.md.
style_prompt_template: a bold cartoon sticker-style illustration of {ingredient}, thick near-black outline, flat saturated natural colors, simple cel shading with one darker tone and small white glossy highlights, minimal interior detail lines, single object centered at a slight three-quarter angle filling most of the canvas, plain transparent background, no text, no cast shadow, no gradients, playful children's-cookbook energy
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, photorealism, 3d render, gradients, drop shadow, background scenery, pattern, multiple objects, hands, humans, border, frame

output.aspect: roughly square; subject fills ~80% of canvas
output.note: the pink blob behind the recipe hero is drawn by the UI (IllustrationPlaceholder), never baked into the generated image

attributes.rendering_style: bold cartoon sticker / flat vector look (clean shapes, even fills)
attributes.palette: full-saturation natural food colors — NOT the UI pastel chips; art color = the food's real color, amped
attributes.shading: simple cel shading: one darker tone per surface + occasional lighter patch
attributes.highlights: small white glossy crescents/dots on the upper-left of rounded forms
attributes.composition: single object, centered, slight three-quarter tilt, generous margin, no cropping
attributes.background_treatment: fully transparent; UI supplies any blob/tile behind it
attributes.detail_level: icon-simple for single ingredients; denser interior linework allowed for composed dishes (burger, salad bowl)
attributes.motifs: rounded friendly silhouettes; nothing anthropomorphized; no faces on food
attributes.cuteness: playful children's-cookbook energy, but food stays food (the chef mascot is the only character)

category_variation.finding: NO systematic style change by category. Color follows each food's natural color; meats carry extra marbling/texture strokes, produce reads simpler. Category color-coding lives in the UI pastel chips (tokens/colors.json ingredient.*), never in the artwork.

variants.dish: same language, more interior detail permitted — used for recipe heroes and recipe-card images
variants.character: chef mascot: retro-cartoon human in the same ink-outline language (static asset, not generated)
variants.scene: Login kitchen background: full scene, softer earthy palette (static asset, EXCLUDED from this template)

normalized: Source assets came from at least two different generators (Gemini + ChatGPT per layer names) yet already agree closely; template reflects their common denominator. Tomato asset doubles as the app logo icon.
